Profile
A collaborative practitioner who combines careful analysis with practical delivery. I work from the first conversation through handover, making decisions visible and explaining trade-offs to colleagues with different backgrounds. My focus is on useful, maintainable work, clear documentation and steady improvements informed by the people who use it. I enjoy sharing knowledge, making ownership explicit and adapting plans as requirements change. Regular feedback helps me keep the work useful and understandable for everyone involved.

- Designed reproducible benchmarks for scheduling experiments.
- Explained uncertainty and limitations to partner teams.
- Maintained a shared catalogue of experimental results.
- Gathered feedback in regular conversations and translated recurring issues into practical, testable next steps for the team.
- Aligned priorities with neighbouring teams and recorded decisions, trade-offs and open questions in a shared working document.
- Checked outcomes against agreed examples and discussed unexpected results early with the people responsible for follow-up.
